title: Medici family mystery may be solved after more than 400 years
summary: Scientists have used DNA analysis to solve a centuries-old mystery surrounding the Medici family, one of history's most influential Renaissance dynasties, after over 400 years of uncertainty, likely related to malaria as suggested by genetic evidence from remains.
problem_solved: Solving a 400-year-old historical mystery about the cause of death or genetic traits of the powerful Medici family using modern DNA technology.
why_valuable: It demonstrates how ancient DNA analysis can provide definitive answers to historical questions that traditional scholarship cannot resolve, bridging archaeology with modern genetics.
